title: Never remove the focus ring without a 3:1 replacement
rule: In a component's `:focus-visible` rule, do not set `outline: none` (or 0) to replace the global 2 px accent ring with a background tint. A hover tint such as `--fm-hover` is about 1.1:1, far under the 3:1 a focus indicator needs. Keep the global ring (use a negative `outline-offset` when a clipping parent would cut it) or draw your own 2 px accent ring, and add a contrast.test.ts check that the rule never sets `outline: none|0`.
rationale: E50.9 (#580): the Characters cell context menu set `outline: none` on its focused item, so keyboard users saw only a faint hover tint.
